variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'let them give it': the qere ויתנהו (3ms suffix) and the ketiv ויתנה (read as a suffixed form of the same verb) both yield 'give it'; the English pronoun 'it' carries no gender or form distinction and there is no italic supply or mapped textual note, so the wording does not distinguish the readings. Base qere fallback retained.

ASV 'the workmen that are in the house of Jehovah': the ketiv בבית has the preposition explicitly, but the qere בית (construct without preposition, adverbial 'at/in the house') is rendered the same way in English; 'in' is not italicized as a supply and no textual note is mapped to this unit, so the wording permits both. Base qere fallback retained.
